Your original card works. Your ceramic fondue pot (order h438-o1) is delivered, was returned to the shop and is within the refund window (refund-policy/v2/return, refund-policy/v2/window). I've made a refund proposal for **53.90 BRL** (refund-policy/v2/amount).
